text: The knocks still hanging in the air. His father opens the door. Lantern light — and a woman in gray robes carrying all three house trims, and a single gold thread. Two riders wait at the gate. She has come to the door alone.

speaker: Hesta
text: Kai of Oakstead. Found sixteen years ago. Woke yesterday's light. I am Hesta, Director of the Vael Academy.
His mother steps in front of him. It is not subtle. The Director does not appear to mind.

speaker: Essa
text: He's a boy. He's OUR boy—

speaker: Hesta
text: He is. That is not in dispute. And it changes nothing. Every awakened talent in Aldreth belongs to Vael for the training of it. The law is older than the crown, and it does not knock twice.

speaker: Tam
text: And if we refuse?

speaker: Hesta
text: Then next week the law arrives with a warrant and forty soldiers instead of an old woman and two tired riders. I came myself so that it would arrive with a face. This one. Not theirs.
Kai steps around his mother — gently, moving her behind him without seeming to. His first instinct, always: get between.

speaker: Kai
text: It's alright, Ma. …I'll go.
The Director's eyes go to his brow. She looks at the mark for exactly as long as it takes to read a single word — and says nothing at all.

speaker: Hesta
text: Be ready at first light. Pack for four days. The Academy provides the rest.
She turns. Stops. Without looking back—

speaker: Hesta
text: Bring the sword.
Silence. His mother's hand finds the table. Nobody outside that kitchen knows about the sword. Nobody has EVER known about the sword.

speaker: Kai
text: How do you know about—

speaker: Hesta
text: Be ready at first light.
What was said around that table that night — the last night — belongs to the three of them. Even I won't repeat it.
First light. The gate. His mother presses a cloth bundle into his hands — bread, still warm from the oven. Neither of them says why that, of all things. Both of them know.
His father checks the sword-belt buckle. Tightens it one hole. Steps back. Nods once. It is, from Tam, a speech.

speaker: Essa
text: You come home. Whatever they make of you in that place — you COME HOME.

speaker: Kai
text: I will. …I promise.
He walks. He looks back exactly once, at the turn where the road drops toward the valley — and they are both still standing there, exactly as he knew they would be.
Four days to Vael, the Director had said. But the road, as roads do… had a story of its own.
